name: glass
description: A desktop-app look for Claude Code's terminal: colored shell commands in prose, a Bottom line card, content-fit code cards, borderless tables, gutter marks beside paragraphs that need you, prompt and reply bubbles with a hover copy button, and one activity line per reply.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Color palette for inline code, headings and cards

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Native notification when a background agent finishes after its turn, or a turn ends with failed calls

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Draw the pictures Claude looks at once the activity line is open: screenshots MCP tools return (chrome-devtools, Figma) and images it reads, never one you named. Off by default: a devtools run takes a screenshot each step

hint.title: Formatting hint
hint.description: Send the model one short line (about 250 characters) naming what glass draws: tables, alerts, mermaid, figure, runnable fences. Sent with the first prompt of a session and the first after a compaction
